notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk.
description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker, triggering the ability given to it by Pip-Boy 3000, untapping all lands you control.
During the end of combat step, activate Desert's second ability by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and then untapping it and causing you to gain an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.name: Bruce Banner // The Incredible Hulk
uses.cardState: as The Incredible Hulk and without summoning sickness
